Months after the [[Battle of Hoth]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] went on a '''mission''' to the terrestrial [[planet]] of [[Batuu]] in hopes of finding intel regarding [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]].
